sentences.japanese: 寝てるな、寝ながらお金を稼げるなら別だが。
sentences.english: Don't stay in bed, unless you can make money in bed.

sentences.japanese: 君は彼と別れるのが賢明だろう。
sentences.english: You will do well to leave him.

sentences.japanese: 結婚式のためにお金を別に取っておいたほうがいい。
sentences.english: You had better set some money apart for your wedding.

sentences.japanese: 君のシャツは破れている。別のシャツを着た方がいい。
sentences.english: Your shirt is torn. You better put on another shirt.

sentences.japanese: 君のアイディアは新しいとは言えない。私は去年、それを別の筋から聞いた。
sentences.english: Your idea cannot be brand new. I heard about it from another source last year.
